meta_description:
1,650 likes, 76 comments - ankurwarikoo on September 29, 2026: "The festival sale is about to begin. 

But before that, here’s a 7-day money detox.

Day 1 - Turn off all shopping app notifications.

Day 2 - Open your UPI mandate list - the auto-pay list. Cancel every subscription you don’t use.

Day 3 - Make a shopping list for the festive season and commit that you won’t buy more than this.

Day 4 - Whatever you want to buy, check its price from last month.

Because during a sale, the discounts look very attractive. But it’s important to know at what price the discount is offered.

Day 5 - On Instagram, mute all those accounts that are always telling you to buy something. They are generating FOMO.

Day 6 - Anything over ₹5,000, you’ll apply the 72-hour rule.

If you truly need that thing after three days, only then will you buy it.

Day 7 - Most important.

You’ll make a budget for this festive season. No spending beyond that, and someone else should know this budget, not just you.

Spend money responsibly this year.".
